**p25:** Normal Summoning Vata is the right play. Black Whirlwind searches a Blackwing with less than 800 ATK, such as Oroshi. Vata then sends itself plus Simoon (2 + 6 = 8) to summon Black-Winged Dragon, and Black Feather Whirlwind revives a Blackwing.

**p34:** Tributing Simoon (B) is the strongest choice. Keeping Sudri and Vata leaves enough for Full Armor Master plus Assault Dragon. Answer A is a mistake: it rests on a misread, because Sudri's search and its Tribute effect have separate once-per-turn limits.

**p24:** Building Full Armor Master plus Assault Dragon through Boreastorm (B) is best, even though Maxx "C" gives the opponent more draws. Going straight to Full Armor Master (C) is a reasonable cautious option. Summoning Dark Armed Dragon now (A) gives up a draw for a body with no targets this turn. Answer B's reason wrongly names Time Thief as the opponent; only Maxx "C" has been seen.

positions.assessment: You have no monsters, and both Whirlwinds are face-up. Normal Summoning Vata makes Black Whirlwind search a Blackwing with less than 800 ATK (Oroshi, Sharnga, Gofu or Chinook). Vata then sends itself plus Deck Blackwings totalling 8 to summon Black-Winged Dragon, and Black Feather Whirlwind revives a Blackwing. That can lead to Full Armor Master (revived Vata + BWD) or Armor Master plus more bodies. Ahrima lines are much weaker, since its Tribute effect has no other DARK monster to use and Simoon needs an empty board.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: This uses your Normal Summon to start the whole engine: a Black Whirlwind search, then Black-Winged Dragon, then a Black Feather Whirlwind revive. The plan in the reason is correct.

positions.assessment: Icarus Attack needs one Winged Beast Tribute. Keeping Sudri and Vata is the strongest route: Vata summons Black-Winged Dragon, and Harmattan comes out copying Sudri. Sudri's Tribute effect, which is still unused, makes a Lv2 Tuner token. Token + Sudri make Boreastorm set to Lv2, Boreastorm + Black-Winged Dragon make Full Armor Master, and Assault Dragon comes out by banishing the two from the GY. Keeping Simoon instead tops out at about Full Armor Master + Simoon.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: The reason is wrong: Sudri's Tribute-for-token effect is separate from its search and is still available. Losing Sudri removes the Tuner route to Boreastorm and Assault Dragon.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: Simoon is the least useful body here. Keeping Vata (for Black-Winged Dragon) and Sudri (for the token) allows Full Armor Master plus Assault Dragon.

positions.assessment: Maxx "C" is active, and the opponent already holds 7 cards. One line is Boreastorm (Sharnga + Sudri) at Lv2, then Full Armor Master (Boreastorm + Black-Winged Dragon), then Assault Dragon. That builds the deck's best board for 3 more draws. Full Armor Master straight away (Sharnga + Black-Winged Dragon) costs only 1 draw but leaves just Full Armor Master + Sudri. Dark Armed Dragon now is a 2800 body with no targets this turn, and it gives the opponent a draw.

grades.label: A
grades.reason: Summoning it now does keep Dark Armed Dragon usable before the GY count rises, but it gives a Maxx "C" draw for a body with nothing to destroy this turn. It is also exposed before your next turn.

grades.label: B
grades.reason: This is the strongest board: Full Armor Master plus Assault Dragon, worth the extra draws. The reason wrongly assumes a Time Thief opponent, but the line itself is right.

grades.label: C
grades.reason: This is a sound cautious line against Maxx "C": a single summon for Full Armor Master, with Sudri kept. It gives up Assault Dragon, though.
